blurb: Over ETR in four of five on minutes far above his usual (18-40 against 12), though the latest was in line on 18. ETR has caught up to the role. Expect around a low-to-mid-teens number while the minutes last.

name: Malik Monk
blurb: Never over: 1 under and 4 in line. Minutes swing (3-24) around a usual 16.

name: Precious Achiuwa
blurb: Never over: four in line and one under, with his minutes tracking Sabonis (36 with him out, 14 with him back). ETR has priced him below his usual. Expect a mid-to-high-teens number with Sabonis playing, more if he sits.

name: Zach LaVine
blurb: In line three of five, over once on 6-9 from three, under once on 25 minutes. Minutes are steady at 33-36 otherwise. Expect his high-20s number.

name: De'Aaron Fox
blurb: Mixed: two unders (cold 3-10; 2-6 in a blowout) and two in line, then an over: 17-4-9 with 3 stocks. Minutes run 29-33 in close games. Expect in line with his low-30s number, under in a San Antonio rout.

name: Devin Vassell
blurb: Never over: in line four times, under once in a 22-point win. Minutes 21-36 with SAS game script. Right on his number.

name: Dylan Harper
blurb: Three unders in five, all on lost minutes (28 in a blowout, 28 with 5 fouls) or no assists and stocks, then a big over: 18-6-10 with 5 stocks on 36 minutes. Minutes sit around 31 in normal games. Expect in line with his low-30s number.

name: Julian Champagnie
blurb: Never over: three in line and two unders, one with 0-6 shooting and 5 fouls. Minutes have run 21-27 against a usual 26. Expect in line with his low-20s number.

name: Keldon Johnson
blurb: Mixed: one over, two in line, two unders on light scoring (4 points twice). Minutes sit at 26-28. Expect in line with his low-20s number.

name: Luke Kornet
blurb: Steady and small: four in line and one under on 13-18 minutes. Expect a mid-teens number.

name: Stephon Castle
blurb: Never over and slipping: three in line, then two unders on cold shooting (2-10; 5-13 with 1 rebound and 3 assists). Minutes are steady at 29-30. Expect a little under his mid-30s number until the shot comes back.

name: Victor Wembanyama
blurb: The biggest range on the board: overs of 112.8 and 83.7, an in line 64.3 on 7 stocks, one under in a 24-minute blowout. Efficient shooting and blocks drive it, and only San Antonio blowouts cut his minutes. Expect at or above his low-60s number in a close game.

name: Alijah Martin
blurb: Minutes well above his usual (16, 31, 21, 16 against 10): a 38.3 on 6-7 from three, a 12.1 when ETR priced him up, then an in-line 18.2. Expect a mid-teens number while the minutes last.

name: Allen Graves
blurb: A small role growing a little: minutes 9-20 against a usual 13, two overs and two in line, the latest 19.0 on 3-4 from three. Expect a low number with occasional pops.

name: Collin Murray-Boyles
blurb: Over in three of five (by 7-15) on 28-34 minutes and stocks (5 on 11-06, 6 last time). Minutes are well above his usual 22. The role is real; the stocks are spiky. Expect at or above a mid-20s number.

name: Immanuel Quickley
blurb: In line three of five, under once (3-14 back from the hamstring), over by 15 last time on 26 points (8-16). Minutes 28-38. Expect his low-30s number.

name: Jakob Poeltl
blurb: Over by 25 and 13 on 31 minutes with Barnes out, then 18.3 and 22.5 as the role normalized. Minutes have stayed 25-32, above his usual 24. Expect near his number.

name: Ja'Kobe Walter
blurb: Never over: under in three of five, by 10-13, on 4-13 and 2-8 nights with no stocks. Minutes are steady at 27-35. Trust him below his mid-20s number.

name: Jamal Shead
blurb: Two big overs with Barnes and Quickley out (16 assists; 20 and 11 on 34-36 minutes), then under twice at 22 minutes with Quickley back (1-6 both). The role shrinks with the starters in. Expect below his number when Toronto is healthy.

name: Jamison Battle
blurb: Mixed: 1 over, 3 in line and 1 under. Minutes went 20, 19, 17, 21, then 19 against a usual 16, so the role is bigger than his average says. Rebounding below his rate in 2 of 5.

name: RJ Barrett
blurb: In line three of five, under by 15 on 7-21, over by 16 last time (31 and 14 on 13-20). Minutes are steady at 31-37. Expect his mid-30s number with shooting the swing.

name: Scottie Barnes
blurb: Three overs in five, then a -12 last night on 5 turnovers in a loss. Minutes steady around 35; ETR prices him above his usual, so his number is fair.

name: Ace Bailey
blurb: Mixed: two early unders, two in line (23 on 10-15 with Markkanen out), then an over on 6 stocks. Minutes are steady at 29-35. Expect in line with his around-30 number, more with Markkanen out.

name: Darryn Peterson
blurb: Scoring above his rate in four of five: two overs (5 stocks; 35 minutes with Markkanen out), two in line, one cold under. Minutes are steady at 30-35. Expect at or a little above his mid-30s number.

name: Isaiah Collier
blurb: A backup whose role comes and goes: minutes swung 3-24, and the 24 last night produced 31.5 (in line against ETR's 26.6). ETR priced him above his usual for that game (27 vs 17). If the minutes hold, a real number; if not, a low one.

name: Jaxson Hayes
blurb: Never over: three in line and two unders (2 points; 17 minutes with 4 fouls). Minutes swing 17-30 around a usual 24. Expect in line with his low-20s number.

name: Josh Okogie
blurb: Never under, on more minutes than his average (19-28 lately, usual 14), with two overs. It's a small role, but it's growing; expect him at or over his number.

name: Keyonte George
blurb: Mixed: two overs (39 points on 44 minutes; one with Markkanen out), one in line, two unders on cold shooting (3-12; 3-13 back from the ankle). Minutes sit at 30-33. Expect in line with his mid-30s number once the ankle settles.

name: Kyle Filipowski
blurb: A fringe big: 8-9 minutes early, then 15 minutes and a +15 over with Markkanen out. ETR has had him well below his usual. Only worth a look when Utah's frontcourt is short.

name: Lauri Markkanen
blurb: Never under: over twice (31 minutes, then 39) and in line on 8-15 from three last time. Minutes 29-39 against a usual 30. He's at or above his number.

name: AJ Dybantsa
blurb: In line four of five, under once on 6-15. Minutes run 30-44, but the shooting has been cold (2-10 in 44 overtime minutes). A floor play near his high-20s number.

name: Alex Sarr
blurb: Over in his last two, by 26 in a 44-minute overtime game and by 16 last time on 25 points (9-13) in 27 minutes. Before that two unders with AD back. Hot shooting drove both overs; expect his mid-to-high 20s number with a real ceiling.

name: Anthony Davis
blurb: Over three times (by 7-21) and in line once, then under by 7 last time on 4-11 in 31 minutes. Minutes run 30-44. A cold night; expect his mid-40s number.

name: Bilal Coulibaly
blurb: In line four of five, one 0-8 dud in a blowout. Minutes are steady at 20-29, mostly scoring little but chipping in stocks. Expect his high-teens number.

name: Bub Carrington
blurb: Mixed and slipping: three in line, one over on stocks, then 0.0 in 10 minutes. Minutes swing 10-21 around a usual 19, and ETR priced him below his usual last time. Expect a low number.

name: Deandre Ayton
blurb: Swings with his minutes: an over on 23 minutes and 11 rebounds, unders on 24 minutes with 4 points and 7 minutes in a blowout. Minutes 7-24. No trend; expect his number with a low floor.

name: Khris Middleton
blurb: Spot minutes (12-23), two unders and two in line, single digits most nights. Not a draftable role until the minutes settle.

name: Kyshawn George
blurb: Under twice (5 turnovers; 6 fouls), over once in a blowout, in line twice, the latest 31.4 with 4 stocks on cold shooting. With AD back the role is smaller than in early November. Expect his low-30s number.

name: Trae Young
blurb: Under in three of five, by 10-23; the latest was 0-5 in 26 minutes of a 28-point loss. The one over was 45 overtime minutes. Washington's blowouts cost him; expect a bit under his number in a likely mismatch.

name: Tre Johnson
blurb: Over three of five, by 7-15, on 27-30 minutes against a usual 21, with two in-line nights on brutal shooting (2-15, 1-8). The minutes are the sticky part; ETR is still in the low-to-mid teens, so expect him to beat it more often than not.

name: Will Riley
blurb: A fringe role: 1, 5 and 20 minutes in his three games, in line each time against ETR's low numbers. Expect little unless the minutes stick.
